 MLB announces the Brewers starting lineup ahead of Game 4 
 Milwaukee Brewers starting pitcher Dustin May throws during the first inning in Game 3 of baseball's National League Division Series against the San Diego Padres Tuesday, Oct. 6, 2026, in San Diego. (AP Photo/Derrick Tuskan) (Derrick Tuskan | AP Photo/Derrick Tuskan) By WBAY news staff Published : Oct. 27, 2026 at 3:59 PM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google MILWAUKEE, Wis. (WISN/WBAY) - The Milwaukee Brewers and Tampa Bay Rays are playing in a World Series that will produce a first-time champion and likely baseball’s first all-indoor championship.
 Brewers lead the series 3-0 in the best-of-seven showdown between the two top teams in MLB.
 MLB announces the Brewers starting lineup:
 RHP Dustin May will be the starting pitcher for the Brew Crew.
 Jackson Chourio (R) LF 
 Jake Bauers (L) 1B 
 Christian Yelich (L) DH 
 William Contreras (R) C 
 Brice Turang (L) 2B 
 Sal Frelick (L) RF 
 Cooper Pratt (R) SS 
 Garrett Mitchell (L) CF 
 David Hamilton (L) 3B 
 RHP Griffin Jax will start for the Rays.
